description: Range elements are filtering syntax used after the 'range' keyword in 3DEC commands. They select subsets of blocks, zones, gridpoints, faces, contacts and subcontacts by geometric region, attribute, or logical condition.

examples: block contact property friction 25 range jmodel 'mohr'
notes: Multiple range elements create intersection (AND) by default
Unspecified range affects all objects of target type

3DEC 7.00 Release 161 (2026-08-21): all 22 documented range elements appear in the live 7.0 range-slot enumeration (probed via 'block hide' — 67 tokens, a superset with unified-kernel extras such as project-range/undo). No documented element is missing in 7.0.
live_note: Live-verified 2026-08-14 against 3DEC 9.7.47: the block-hide first slot enumerates the full range-element vocabulary shown in live_enumeration_97 (62 tokens incl. the operators not/union/by and hide modifiers remove/undo/use-hidden/set). All 22 documented elements are present; the ~37 undocumented extras include unified-kernel entries (wall, contact, ...) - acceptance of a token does not imply 3DEC data behind it. 3DEC is 3D-only: no 2D-specific elements (circle/radius) appear.
